title: Multi-stage image requiring no external base
expected: Build a data-only OCI image without network or downloaded base layers.
scratch is Docker's empty base, not an unpinned remote tag.

cases.name: argument-base
cases.change: Use variants/argument-base with alpine:3.22 explicitly tagged as oyzu-fixture/alpine:amd64 for the Linux AMD64 executor; global ARG defaults and captured TARGETARCH compose the base reference.
cases.expect: Native expansion records target/epoch facts and resolves the captured base without ambient values. Native RUN observes the declared target architecture and fixed epoch. Missing defaults producing an empty base fail preparation.

cases.name: image-aliases
cases.change: Use variants/image-aliases with alpine:3.22 provisioned; FROM, external COPY and an image-backed RUN mount use equivalent short and qualified references.
cases.expect: Preserve both requested references in the input evidence, use one native context only when captured identities agree, and retain copied content without persisting the temporary mount.

cases.name: provisioned-base
cases.change: Use variants/provisioned-base with alpine:3.22 explicitly provisioned in the executor Docker store.
cases.expect: Capture the immutable image during preparation, build from its OCI store offline, retain input identity and produce repeatable snapshots; missing images fail preflight without pulling.

cases.name: external-add
cases.expect: Reject undeclared external acquisition before a hermetic action.

cases.name: quality-gates
cases.change: Introduce noncanonical Dockerfile spacing or a relative WORKDIR.
cases.expect: Native read-only format or lint checks fail, preserve source, and block final OCI artifacts.

cases.name: ignored-quality-config
cases.change: Configure native Hadolint and EditorConfig, then exclude those files using .dockerignore.
cases.expect: The checkers use the captured configuration while the image COPY context excludes it.

limitations: Oyzu CLI/build/agent integration is pending; native checks do not prove policy, sandbox, cache, reporting, or release behavior.
